answer: Before filing, every worker makes a short voyage through the Opal hall, checking three other workers' claims and leaving a signed service stamp on each; the Garden desk confirms the stamps and their times within a day, and a claim with no stamps, or stamps timed seconds apart, is rejected and forfeits a 150-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 3,000 real checks plus 150,000 coins in bonds. One operator filed forty claims without a single stamp, and every one died at the Garden desk.
